description: Check that the WeCom (企业微信 / WeChat Work) connection works: fetches a fresh access_token with Corp ID and app secret, then reads the app itself (name, visibility scope) with it — an authenticated read, not just a reachability check. Use right after entering Corp ID, Agent ID and secret. Tells apart a wrong secret (40001), a wrong Corp ID (40013), a wrong Agent ID (40056) and the trusted-IP block (60020: apps created after 2022-06-20 only accept calls from whitelisted IPs). Changes nothing.
name: test_wecom_connection
